svg.title: CPU BAM StandUp: published policy and owned checkpoint 2750
svg.desc: Median and range of trunk height and tilt for the same 16 initial poses. The published official policy recovers from face-down and face-up starts, while owned checkpoint 2750 remains tilted or down. This is a policy behavior comparison, not proof of reproducing the same training run.
